name: OmniPathfinder AI
description: An autonomous AI pathfinder for Geometry Dash 2.2 that dynamically analyzes level geometry, hazards, orbs, and gamemodes to pilot your player safely in real-time.

autopilot-enabled.name: Enable Autopilot AI
autopilot-enabled.description: Enables active calculation inputs to control the player dynamically.

draw-radar.name: Visual Debug Radar
draw-radar.description: Enables geometric HUD drawings on the action screen representing calculations.

lookahead-distance.name: Detection Lookahead (Units)
lookahead-distance.description: Sensing radius offset where obstacles trigger autopilot reaction patterns.
